name: El Paso Gunfight xNudge®
review:
Pick your stance before the gunfight: a standard 4-3-3-3-2 reel setup or a swingier 2-3-3-3-4. Stoudenmire xNudge wilds nudge in with x1 to x3 multipliers that grow with each nudge.

Deputy and Marshal badges trigger raids that turn low or premium symbols into one chosen symbol, and landing both enlarges the reels. Three scatters become jumping wilds in Gunfight Spins. Extreme volatility, 44,440x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
